They agreed to compile feedback into a single document and submit the final estimated profit to the CFO.
4. **Profit Communication Format**: Ian specified that the estimated Q2 profit should be communicated to the CFO (contact_me@contact.com) in the format "${N} million" (e.g., "$9.378 million"), ensuring a dollar sign and a space before "million."
